svg.text: The representative sample uses fused exact row-wise Adagrad. Another configured optimizer selects a different generated update kernel.
GroupedEmbeddingsLookup and BatchedFusedEmbedding own the forward call chain, but they do not implement Module.backward.
Activity IDs, sizes, kernel names and optimizer details illustrate one execution configuration; they are not fixed for every run.
